UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
NAAC A++ Accredited
Hazratbal, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir - 190006, India
Notice
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application forms in
response to Advertisement Notice No. 05 of 2025, dated July 01, 2025 for the post of Deputy
Librarian, under categories, Open Merit, SC, ST-1, ST-2, that the provisional list of applicants
along with the deficiencies, if any, is given in Annexure(s) to this Notice. Further, if a candidate
finds any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may approach the office of the
Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary evidences by or before, 07
October, 2025 on all working days during office hours.
No claim, whatsoever, after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
Further, the interview for the said post will be conducted only when the minimum of three
(03) candidates are eligible in each category.
By Order -sd-
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
